title: Volume 1 Chapter 1: Kyouka Uzen's Arc 1
content: "I've arrived, Yuki. This is it."
Kyouka Uzen had brought her slave, Yuki Wakura, to a rest facility of the Anti-Demon Corps located in Kochi Prefecture, just the two of them.
"This building is well-maintained, isn't it?"
Yuki, who loved cleaning, was impressed by the small but clean structure.
"Here, we can train well. If something happens in Mato, we can respond immediately."
The dormitory of the 7th Squad in Mato was directly connected to this facility in Kochi.
"What do you mean by being able to train well in the mountains?"
"I've gained strength through my training on the Sacred Mountain."
Kyouka took a deep breath.
"The holy air of Deep Mountain suits my skin."
"I see, the air is delicious."
"If we're in Shikoku, I'd be interested in Mount Ishizuchi or Mount Tsurugi, but this place is also good."
The battles against the Shuki, monsters that harm humanity, were intensifying.
Kyouka and Yuki needed to accumulate further strength through training.
To that end, they had entrusted their absence to Vice-Captain Himari Azuma and set off on their journey to train.
"There are no other people here besides us, right?"
"They just prepared supplies like food inside the rest facility."
"They'll come back to replenish tomorrow?"
"They should provide accurate resupply."
Kyouka answered Yuki's questions promptly.
The abilities of the Anti-Demon Corps are classified.
With no one around, we can move our transformed bodies without hesitation, right?
We need to take care of ourselves, though.
"Leave the housework to me, Konomi Tatara!!"
Yuki replied with sparkling eyes and confidence.
He had great confidence in his housework skills, honed by his tyrant sister since childhood.
"I just found a little dirt in that corner. It's a spot that's easy to overlook."
Yuki crouched down and pointed out the dirt he had discovered to Kyouka.
"But it's fine; for dirt like this, we can use baking soda."
"Hey, Yuki."
When Yuki came back to his senses, Kyouka was looking down at him with an exasperated gaze.
He couldn't help but feel a jolt at her sharp beauty.
"We didn't come here to clean the rest facility. You don't need to worry about the details."
"R-right. When I see dirt, my body just moves on its own."
"When you come to a new building, you always check if it's being maintained."
"It's almost like a professional deformation."
"Well, whatever."
Kyouka lightly ruffled Yuki's hair, as if to say he was a hopeless case.
"Now, our goal here is to intensively train our bodies for three days."
"I want to level up significantly."
"Besides the major goal of gaining strength, how about we set some kind of secondary goal for each other?"
"A secondary goal?"
"Like learning a new dish or correcting a bad habit—something positive."
"Sounds good; it seems like it will be a fulfilling three days."
Alright, let's write our secondary goals in our notebooks.
The contents will be a secret between us.
Then we'll check if we've achieved them on the final day.
"It sounds fun, like a game."
"The former leader of the 7th Squad used to do this kind of thing sometimes; it's a good diversion."
"The former leader... right, Kyouka-san wasn't the leader from the start."
"Everyone starts as a regular member."
"Now that I think about it, isn't it quite fast to become a leader?"
"One year to become Vice-Captain, and a year and a half to become Captain."
While talking, Kyouka wrote down her secondary goal in her notebook.
"I've written mine."
"What should my secondary goal be? Hmm, I'm unsure."
"You don't need to overthink it. Just do it quickly."
Kyouka lightly tapped Yuki's shoulder with her notebook.
"D-don't rush me when it's just a diversion!"
"Well, I might wait a little."
While saying that, Kyouka was pacing behind Yuki, urging him with her attitude.
"Kyouka-san, is your pulse faster than normal?"
"Sorry for being impatient. My sympathetic and parasympathetic nerves are functioning without issues."
Finally, Yuki wrote down his secondary goal in his notebook.
"Alright. After we drop off our bags, let's start training right away!"
Kyouka said, cracking her knuckles.
"Training. It sounds great. Just saying it makes my heart race."
"Yes!!"
"That's a good response. That's how my slave should be."
Yuki's training wasn't limited to just cleaning skills.
In this world, where only women could use abilities, he naturally learned the necessary hierarchy to navigate life smoothly.
With Kyouka's ability, "Slave," Yuki transformed into a different form.
He was deeply grateful for this ability that provided him with a chance to shine.
"Alright, let's run around the surrounding mountains first."
With that, Kyouka mounted Yuki, who had transformed.
This state of being mounted meant that Kyouka's sensations were directly transmitted to his body, but Yuki had no time to be flustered.
"Push yourself harder; you can go faster!"
The strict command from his master, Kyouka, came flying at him.
Even during training, he couldn't let his guard down for a moment.
"Good pace, Yuki. Well done. I'll give you the next instructions."
While occasionally praising the hard-working slave, Kyouka continued to refine Yuki's precision.
It had been less than six months since they became master and slave, but their teamwork had reached a considerable level.
Yuki dashed through the mountains of Kochi with abandon.
"Yuki, imagine a Shuki appearing right in front of you."
Yuki expanded his imagination and took down the air Shuki.
"That was a good thrust. You effectively swept away three Shuki."
"You could see that I envisioned three of them, Kyouka-san?"
"What kind of master wouldn't know what their slave is thinking?"
Since they had arrived at the rest facility close to evening, the sun had already begun to set.
"Let's call it a day for now."
Yuki had prepared himself for Kyouka's nature, expecting training to continue into the night.
"Return to the rest facility and revert your transformation, Yuki."
"I'm still good to go, Kyouka-san!"
"We've been busy even before coming here, so let's rest at night. I can tell your body is accumulating fatigue."
With that, Kyouka lightly stroked Yuki's body.
"You can even tell that? Truly an expert in hand-to-hand combat."
"I've been dealing with muscles for a long time."
Kyouka rubbed her own abs.
"They say those who train can hear their bodies speaking to them, and that's true."
"What are your abs saying right now, Kyouka-san?"
"They're saying they want energy soon."
"That's a problem; let's head back."
Yuki knew that he could endure hunger with iron will as a master.
Kyouka genuinely cared for Yuki's body.
So she created an atmosphere that made it easy to return.
Grateful for her consideration, Yuki returned to the rest facility as instructed.
"We've arrived."
Yuki reverted to his human form.
"You ran a lot. You didn't involve anything else, and you did well."
Then Kyouka grabbed Yuki's body and gently tossed him.
Yuki fell softly to the ground.
It didn't hurt because she had lightly pulled him up before slamming him down.
"I think you understand, but the reward for using your ability has begun."
Kyouka placed her hand on the button of her jacket.
"Y-yes."
Kyouka's ability, "Slave," required her to provide a reward to those she commanded.
Until now, Kyouka had been rewarding the Shuki with pork.
However, when she made Yuki her slave to save his life, the reward transformed into kisses.
Since then, the rewards had become physical.
Once someone became a slave, the master couldn't search for another slave until the current one died.
That's why Kyouka said,
"It seems this time it's a massage-type reward."
Yuki had been given rewards consistently every time he transformed, to the point where they could categorize the types of rewards.
"Massage, huh?"
"You seem happy about that? Honestly."
Kyouka removed Yuki's jacket, exposing his upper body.
Now she reached for Yuki's belt.
"Are you taking off the bottom too?"
"I'm not doing this because I like it; it's just the kind of reward it is!"
With a flushed face, Kyouka unbuckled Yuki's belt.
Her white fingers brushed against the zipper of his pants, zipping it down.
Yuki gulped, helping as he lifted his hips to assist in removing his pants.
Now in just his underwear, Yuki lay on the ground while Kyouka stood over him.
In this position, there were rewards for being scolded while being looked down upon and stepped on.
But it seemed this reward was different.
After flipping Yuki onto his stomach, Kyouka mounted him.
"Stay still."
A sweet sensation ran across Yuki's back.
Kyouka extended her tongue, as if licking the sweat off his back.
"You've sweated quite a bit. Lick..."
Kyouka carefully traced her saliva-slicked tongue along Yuki's back.
"Hey, Yuki, don't twitch."
"It tickles."
"Endure it, endure it, chu."
Yuki's back was becoming sticky with Kyouka's saliva.
"Using your tongue for a massage is a strange method... what a pervert."
"I-I'm sorry..."
As Kyouka licked his back and caressed him with her fingers, Yuki occasionally trembled.
"So don't move."
Kyouka whispered in Yuki's ear.
"K-Kyouka-san."
"Don't make such pathetic sounds."
"I'm holding back a lot."
"Don't talk back."
While saying that, she sweetly nibbled on his earlobe.
Though her tone was strict, Kyouka lacked the intensity she had during training.
Rather, it contained a sweetness, as if she were gently instructing a younger lover.
After being massaged with her mouth and hands, Yuki's legs and arms were meticulously kneaded.
"Ooh, that feels good!"
"My body can move freely. This time, let's call it a day here."
In most cases, the rewards corresponded to the level of performance.
Since this time was purely training, the reward ended with a massage on his back and legs.
"This is a voluntary bonus; here, take it."
Kyouka pressed on the pressure points in Yuki's hands.
A tingling pain mixed with an indescribable pleasure surged through him.
"Ahhhhhh!"
"Hehe, it feels good, doesn't it?"
Kyouka laughed as she distanced herself from Yuki.
Yuki took a moment to catch his breath while putting his clothes back on.
At first, it had been awkward after the rewards, but now both of them had gotten used to it.
"Thank you very much. I'll prepare dinner."
"I'll tidy up the paperwork while I wait in anticipation."
On the table, dinner prepared by Yuki was laid out.
Tonight's two main dishes are bonito sashimi and sirloin steak.
We definitely have to highlight the local specialties of Kochi.
The appetizer is lightly pickled summer vegetables, and then...
Yuki rapidly explained the dishes.
Even the serious Kyouka listened attentively.
"Still, to prepare such luxurious ingredients..."
"I've personally contributed money to upgrade the ingredients."
"As expected of you, Kyouka-san."
Food builds the body.
For someone like me who focuses on physicality, it's where I spend my money.
Since I'm busy, I don't spend that much in daily life, so I don't hold back during times like this.
Now, eat without reservation.
"I'll eat without reservation."
"This steak is great. It's rich in meat juices."
"The original ingredients are delicious, after all."
"And it's tender; maybe the cooking is just right."
Kyouka ate quickly, but her movements were precise and elegant.
"The vegetables are also delicious; is there a second helping?"
"Yes, please eat as much as you want."
The two enjoyed their dinner, and while eating peaches for dessert, they slowly sipped tea.
"By the way, how was the taste of the peaches from Mato?"
"They were sweet, like they melted in your mouth. But there was a dangerous sweetness to them."
"They probably wouldn't be suitable as ingredients."
"They're a precious resource from Mato. They can't be used as food."
The entrance to Mato only existed in Japan.
The peaches from Mato, which bestow abilities, were carefully managed by Japan and exported to foreign countries.
"I'm going to play some music."
The song Kyouka played from her device was the theme song of a popular documentary program.
It was sung by a powerful female singer-songwriter.
"I really like this person's songs. They have a lot of emotion."
"You sometimes listen to them, right?"
Saying that, Kyouka gazed at Yuki.
"Yuki, who is your favorite singer?"
"I also like this person. My sister, um, my sister often listened to this singer."
Yuki almost called his sister "nee-chan" but corrected himself.
He used that name when it was just the two of them, but he tried to call her "onee-san" in public.
"Then I'll put on a medley. So, Yuki."
"Yes!"
"You don't need to put too much effort into it right now. Relax. It might be my tone that's making it hard for you."
"Wakura Yuki will relax!"
"Ah. Tonight, I want to talk with you."
"I'm happy. I have a lot of things I want to ask you, Kyouka-san."
"Since you became my slave, it's been a whirlwind of battles and training."
"It went by in a flash."
"But I didn't even know who your favorite singer was. To deepen our connection, we need to know more about each other."
As she said that, Kyouka sipped her tea.
So, Yuki, let's each ask one question from now on.
After you answer a question, it's your turn to ask.
If you can't answer a question, you'll do sit-ups.
Let's go with this rule.
"Sounds good, I understand."
"Alright. Ask me anything."
"Uh, um..."
Suddenly put on the spot, Yuki stumbled over his words.
"Then, Kyouka-san, what's your favorite color?"
"Is that a good question? Well, since it's the first one, I guess it's light. I like silver."
"Ah, the color of a sword."
"I like the feeling of it being refined. Alright, it's my turn."
"Yes, feel free to ask any question."
"Should I go light for my first question too? What was your best subject in elementary school?"
"Probably home economics? I was faster than the girls when it came to taking care of clothes."
"Hehe, you're still like that now."
Kyouka smiled softly, easing Yuki's tension.
"My grades in other subjects and sports were pretty average."
"What about art and music? In elementary school, it would be art class, right?"
"That was average too."
"So home economics was the only subject you excelled in."
"Next is my question, um..."
For example, from the perspective of always serving food, Yuki knew Kyouka's food preferences.
She liked strong flavors, meat, and fish like tuna.
Wanting to ask something that wasn't obvious from her usual behavior, Yuki asked,
"When did you start wearing that headpiece, Kyouka-san?"
"I received it from a girl friend in my hometown when I was a child."
"That's quite a long time ago."
She said, 'Kyou-chan looks good in this,' and I was happy.
But as I grew, it started to not fit, so I used the material to make a larger one.
Kyouka spoke with a distant look in her eyes.
Kyouka's hometown had been destroyed by Shuki that emerged from Mato, and that friend had lost her life.
This incident was recorded as an unprecedented Mato Disaster.
"My turn. What was your dream during your student days, Yuki?"
"Honestly, I didn't have a dream."
"That was a quick answer."
"I thought I would just become an ordinary salaryman and die normally. But I didn't want that."
"Now you're completely not ordinary."
"Yes, I'm grateful."
"Tell me a little more about your student days."
"Not a dream, but during my student days, I thought it would be nice to have a girlfriend."
"Oh. That's healthy. But you couldn't, right?"
"I envied my classmates who had their girlfriends feed them in class."
"If it's just that, I can grant that wish."
Kyouka held a piece of peach on her fork toward Yuki.
"Here, ahh."
"Eh?"
